description: Stake-weighted price oracle on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.31): token holders lock weight tokens, submit prices and earn SOL rewards; the program keeps a time-decayed weighted average. Sol.College runs this lab on its own fork.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration on the Blockchains/OrbOracle-Solana fork. The upstream author (StabilityNexus) has not joined Sol.College and there is no partnership; fixes are offered upstream as ordinary pull requests and acceptance here is by Sol.College's own reviewer, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (initialize, deposit, submit_value, withdraw, blacklist votes)
QA: localnet fixtures and negative cases
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Characterise the time-decayed token-weighted average under skewed submissions and long gaps
